name: @architectcms/mcp

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List all content models defined in Architect CMS, including their fields and metadata.

include_fields.description: Include full field definitions in the response (default true)

tools.name: search_entries
tools.description: Search for entries across all models by text query. Returns matching entries from any content type.

query.description: Text to search for in entry data

tools.name: get_entry_references
tools.description: Get all incoming references to an entry — find which other entries link to it via relation fields.

entry_id.description: The entry ID to find references for

tools.name: list_environments
tools.description: List all available environments (e.g. development, staging, production).

tools.name: switch_environment
tools.description: Change the active environment for all subsequent API calls. Use list_environments to see available options.

environment_id.description: The environment ID to switch to
